extension.summary: Infinity Hook API, Skin API and Adaptive Layout API capability service.
extension.description: Provides Infinity Hook API 1.0, Infinity Skin API 1.0 and Adaptive Layout API 1.0, including stable Window(Home) properties for theme, responsive layout, orientation, usable geometry, performance and refresh state, declarative skin registration, protected player controls, compatibility/safe modes, feature flags and Health Center breadcrumbs while skins keep ownership of Home, widgets and navigation.
